planets.name: K2-198 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-198 with a 7.45-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: K2-198 d was found in 2019 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-198. Its orbit and size follow Hedges et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
